name: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B

based_on.note: OpenBMB's vision model on the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B language backbone (the card credits 'Qwen3.6 for providing the language backbone'), with its own vision encoder.

architecture.anatomy: 35,212,875,824 parameters per the Hugging Face API; '3B active' from the A3B name and the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone

summary: A vision-first MoE from OpenBMB on the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone. OpenBMB reports it ahead of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on 5 of 8 text benchmarks and most vision ones; not independently checked.

practical_baseline.reason: No reported or measured run is recorded yet, and the card gives no literal llama.cpp command.
